title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Hello, Doctor. Have you figured out the style you wanna go with today? Huh...? You didn't call me here for that? I really, really hope you can give it at least a little more thought. Please?

title: Talk 1
original: Watch out! I've got tons of stuff in my pocket here. If this negative ion hair softener bumps into the horn growth stimulant and spills... Well... I could end up getting hanged on the deck! It's no joke!

title: Talk 2
original: You've probably heard how assassins who know their stuff in anatomy work more efficiently, no? Of course, my goal's not to take anyone's hope to survive away. Instead, I want to turn that hope into something more vivid and brilliant! Styling is an art, but it's also a science!

title: Talk 3
original: She looks familiar... Is that the girl who shows up in all those kung fu movies? Whoa, don't ever tell her I'm here! Nah, it's not her that I'm afraid of, but I really don't wanna run into her stylist, Lauder! The last thing I need is anybody calling me 'Bobbi'...

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I'm a researcher, not a modeler, and I definitely don't want to be the kind of girl who works her mindless brush on monotonous faces under spot light day in and day out! Coming on the ship's been kind of like a vacation to me, I guess? If I had to stare at those lifeless faces all day, my brain would get completely fried sooner or later. I'm not doing that no matter how much I get paid.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: If I got no money, I can't buy any new tools or materials. That's why even I got to work sometimes. Hm... I think the girl who came to me last time just got an academy award? She'd be fine to spot me, right?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doctor, I asked Dr. Warfarin for some info about your body... and modified my brush texture based around that. I promise you it won't trigger any allergies this time!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: If you want to touch my hair, go right ahead. It's pretty messy already anyway. Is that weird? When you do styling work for as many people as I do, you definitely won't find yourself in the mood to work on yourself even if you have the time.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Interesting faces are like stories in their own right. Dr. {@nickname}, you are like... a kinda damaged videotape, waiting for someone to dust you off. If the day ever comes that you get repaired, what kind of story will you reveal?

title: Idle
original: Did you really fall asleep? In that case, I guess I can get to work? Your bone structure, your skin... Whoa, this is even more spectacular than I thought!

title: Onboard
original: Hello, I'm Roberta! We meet again! Once I sign here, I'll be your personal stylist, right? Huh... 'You'll be an operator?' Doesn't matter as long as I get to stay!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Beat up all the annoying guys, right? No more difficult than swinging ten brushes around while taking a sip of coffee. I'm from Siracusa, after all.

title: Promotion 1
original: I've got an entire room full of medals like this one back in my studio in Wrankwood... Hey, Doctor, can't you give me something a little more interesting for my reward?

title: Promotion 2
original: Since you're giving me another promotion, I want a bigger studio. You'll approve it, right?

title: Added to Squad
original: Should I go with eyeshadow palette #3001... or perhaps #3002?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Doesn't look like we have a color base that works for all of us...

title: Depart
original: Let's go, everyone! I'll do the re-touch in case your makeup slides off.

title: Begin Operation
original: I know exactly which part of the face is the most fragile!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: You gotta put on the most suitable style even when you're giving out commands in the frontlines.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: These real battlefields give me so much more inspiration than any film set I've been to.

title: Deployment 1
original: Bring your face closer this way, okay? Thanks. I'll pay attention to how much force I use.

title: Deployment 2
original: Even the biggest stars out there gotta book me in advance, you know? You should count yourselves lucky!

title: In Battle 1
original: Surface electrode tracking auto-filling concealer!

title: In Battle 2
original: Infused Originium Slug acid styling spray!

title: In Battle 3
original: Facial bone full structured self-image shading highlighter!

title: In Battle 4
original: Wet/Dry ambient color adapted lipstick and blusher!

title: 4-star Result
original: Whoa... Not even I can replicate that look on your face right now.

title: 3-star Result
original: What a perfect operation. Makes me want to add a few more touches to bring out that joy on your face.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: There's nothing as boring as watching the cowards run. They always stiffen up like Rock Spiders that've spent a bit too much time in antiseptics.

title: Operation Failure
original: Doctor, need me to give your face a little blush? If you go back like this, the others might worry when they look at you.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Can I do my experiments here? Relax, I won't blow the walls out. At most... I guess the doors and windows might bend a little?

title: Tap
original: Didn't I say I'm not seeing anyone...? Oh, it's you.

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, can I come over to your room this evening? Your face could really use a massage.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: New Year, new scenery! Doctor, this stack of paper... Oh, no, actually, all these papers are brand new looks I've been thinking up just for you... Hey! Why are you running away, Doctor?!

title: Greeting
original: Hey, Doctor, want to try this new look I designed just for you?

title: Birthday
original: Tons of celebrities in Wrankwood would ask me to do their makeup for their birthday parties. Cover every trace of time on their faces, no matter the cost. But is that really beauty? Doctor, this mirror's my gift to you. I hope you'll find a true and beautiful you staring back.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I've noticed a lot of operators and patients covering up their Originium crystals. That's not gonna cut it! I've got a plan: I'm going to design a whole set of patterns for decorating your crystals. That's the most meaningful thing I can do for Rhodes Island as a makeup artist!
